original.title: पर्ची ने आज की जगह दस साल पुरानी तारीख़ छाप दी 🧾 | सन्नाटपुर
original.hook: पीसीओ की पर्ची पर दस साल पुरानी तारीख़ छपी थी।

beats.text: पीसीओ की पर्ची पर दस साल पुरानी तारीख़ छपी थी।
beats.scene: Extreme close-up of a narrow paper billing slip inching out of an old mechanical billing machine on the yellow-tinted glass PCO counter, lit by an overhead yellow bulb against deep moonlit blue shadows.

beats.text: उन्नीस सौ छियानवे, उस रात बस्ती के पीले शीशे वाले पीसीओ में हम खड़े थे।
beats.scene: Inside the yellow-tinted glass PCO counter room, prabhat in his mustard sweater and shailesh in his striped shirt stand watching the counter under warm tungsten light, dark night pressing against the yellow glass panes.

beats.text: ट्रंक कॉल कटते ही मशीन की छोटी घंटी बजी, और सरसराती हुई सफ़ेद पर्ची बाहर निकली।
beats.scene: A close shot of the metal meter and billing machine on the yellow-tinted glass PCO counter as the paper slip curls upward under harsh amber light, casting thin shadows across the wooden ledge.

beats.text: शैलेश ने तारीख़ देखकर कहा अरे बाप रे, ये तो छियासी की है, और वो उसे फाड़ने लगा।
beats.scene: At the yellow-tinted glass PCO counter, shailesh in his red cricket cap grips the printed slip between two fingers, about to rip it under the swinging yellow bulb light.

beats.text: झब्बू ने उसका हाथ थामकर कहा, अपने-आप बदली तारीख़ को फाड़ते नहीं, वो कुछ याद दिलाती है।
beats.scene: jhabbu in his khaki kurta and red woollen muffler gently catches shailesh's wrist near the yellow-tinted glass PCO counter, his brass lantern resting beside the phone receiver.

beats.text: काँपते हाथों से पर्ची छूकर चाचा बोले, इसी दिन बेटा शहर गया था और मैं उसे स्टेशन छोड़ने नहीं गया था।
beats.scene: jhabbu and prabhat stand quietly by the yellow-tinted glass PCO counter, looking downward in soft warm lamplight while the cold blue night stays still outside the window.

beats.text: चाचा ने वो काग़ज़ संभालकर रख लिया, पर उस रात पीसीओ की पर्ची पर वही दस साल पुरानी तारीख़ छपी रह गई।
beats.scene: Wide shot of the yellow-tinted glass PCO counter lying quiet under the hanging bulb, the lone billing machine standing silent on the wooden shelf while moonlight washes across the glass.

cast.name: झब्बू
cast.look: elderly grey-haired man about sixty with a grey moustache and a lined face, tall, lean and slightly stooped, khaki kurta and an old grey shawl, red woollen muffler, holding a brass hurricane lantern, bamboo staff with a small bell, khaki ledger with a red spine under one arm, face small and turned away

cast.name: प्रभात

cast.name: शैलेश
cast.look: sturdy eighteen-year-old young man with adult proportions, faded red cricket cap, striped shirt, a small transistor radio in a brown leather case on a shoulder strap, blue rubber flip-flops, seen from behind
